headline: Moderate outlook for long outages in Midland County
summary: Homes in Midland County lose power for 12 hours or more about once every 13 years. That comes from 8 years of records since 2018. The largest outage here began on February 14, 2021. At its peak, 28% of homes in the county were dark. For a home with electric heat, one Core lasts about 18 hours in January and about 37 hours in April. We suggest two Cores. That would have covered 88% of past long outage hours. Base confirms sizing at install.
